title: Coast Guard rescues 5 people from flooding near Grays River, Washington
description: An MH-60 Jayhawk helicopter aircrew from Coast Guard Air Station Astoria rescues five people who were trapped in flooding conditions in Rosburg, Washington, Dec. 5, 2023. The individuals were transported to the air station to awaiting emergency medical services in stable condition. (U.S. Coast Guard courtesy video)
